headline: Profit swings sharply higher against a weak year-ago base
summary_short: J.M. Smucker's fiscal Q4 (quarter ended April 30, 2026) swung to $388.1M net income and $3.64 EPS, from a $43.9M net loss a year ago, as revenue rose 7.3% to $2,268.1M and operating income rose to $449.0M from just $45.6M in the year-ago quarter.
summary_long: This is fiscal Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended April 30, 2026); the 10-K discloses only full-year figures, so no quarter-specific driver is stated. Full-year net sales rose 4% to $9,050.9M on +9pts price realization, offset by -4pts volume/mix; full-year gross profit fell 10% on higher commodity, tariff, and mix costs — the opposite direction from this quarter's own y/y KPI gains above. The full fiscal year closed with a GAAP net loss of $138.7M (vs. a $1,230.8M loss in FY2025), driven by a $961.7M non-cash Sweet Baked Snacks/Hostess impairment taken in fiscal Q3. No forward guidance is stated in this filing.
